_meta.description: The two controls on the moment a sales invoice goes out (REQ-SIIC-001, REQ-SIIC-003). InvoiceNumberSequence: one series per administration, kind and fiscal year, from which AssignInvoiceNumberAction (first action of ARInvoice.issue, declared in add-shillinq-bookkeeping-compliance.json) and InvoiceGenerationService take the next number under a lock. Administration.salesInvoiceApprovalThreshold, and on ARInvoice the states awaiting-approval and approved with the transitions requestApproval, approve (refused to the invoice's creator by SalesInvoiceApprovalGuard::canApprove) and rejectApproval; issue also leaves approved, and from draft it is refused above the threshold (SalesInvoiceApprovalGuard::canIssue, called by RuleComplianceGuard::validateInvoice, the one requires of issue).

InvoiceNumberSequence.title: Invoice number series
InvoiceNumberSequence.description: The invoice number series of one administration, kind and fiscal year: its pattern and the last counter value handed out. Written by the server only, under a lock, when an invoice is issued or generated.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every number handed out raises the counter on the audit trail, so a gap can be traced to the issue that took it.

administrationId.title: Administration
administrationId.description: The administration the series numbers the invoices of.

pattern.title: Pattern
pattern.description: The number pattern: {year} for the fiscal year, {seq:N} for the counter padded to N digits, and literal text.

fiscalYear.title: Fiscal year
fiscalYear.description: The year the series counts; a new year starts again at 1.

lastValue.title: Last value
lastValue.description: The counter of the last number handed out; the next invoice gets this plus one.

salesInvoiceApprovalThreshold.title: Sales invoice approval threshold
salesInvoiceApprovalThreshold.description: A sales invoice whose total including VAT is above this amount is approved by a second person before it is issued. Empty: no approval needed.

approvalRejectionReason.title: Reason for rejection
approvalRejectionReason.description: Why the approver sent the invoice back to draft.

awaiting-approval.label: Awaiting approval
awaiting-approval.description: Above the administration's approval threshold; waits for a second person to approve it.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Approved by someone other than its creator; may be issued.

requestApproval.label: Request approval
requestApproval.description: Send the invoice to a second person for approval before it is issued.

approve.label: Approve
approve.description: Approve the invoice for issue. Refused to the user who created it.

rejectApproval.label: Reject
rejectApproval.description: Send the invoice back to draft, with the reason.
